name: scanned-notes
title: Scanned notes
blurb: Four pages that are pictures of text. There is no text layer to read.
shows: Without OCR the parse returns nothing, so every question is planted to miss. Turn OCR on in the Parse step and every answer comes back.

teaches.why: Every page is a picture with no text layer, so the parse finds no text and nothing can be searched.
teaches.fix_text: In Parse, turn on OCR so every page is read.
